key_points: Q3 revenue grew 9.6% YoY while profits declined, indicating top‑line strength but margin pressure.
Earnings fell 7% last quarter, and the decline has persisted for three consecutive quarters, suggesting a recurring issue.
Bank of America highlighted Chipotle as a top fast‑casual pick, citing improving demand and execution.
Chipotle is reintroducing its second‑entree offer, signaling confidence in customer demand.
AI rollout aimed at waste reduction and faster service is slated for wider 2027 adoption, potentially boosting margins.
